title: Native VIXEN build lock timeout needs a queue-aware wait
body: The queued native build at 127311ba failed after the default 1800-second build-lock wait with no compile diagnostic; rerunning the same build with VIXEN_BUILD_LOCK_TIMEOUT=7200 succeeded after the competing build released the machine-wide lock. The native wrapper should derive or pass the queue-aware lock deadline, or report the owning build and reusable target state before timing out. Tier luna: normal tooling change with a clear wait/deadline contract.

title: Native CMake gate must run in the Windows path namespace
body: The queued WSL command cmake --build /mnt/c/vixen-native/leafinstr2/build/ninja-release --target sdi_merged_drift_gate failed because the CMake cache was created as c:/vixen-native/... and CMake refuses the /mnt/c path namespace. Recovery requires cd /mnt/c and invoking the native cmd.exe/build route, as the native wrapper already does. The VIXEN validation entry point should select the path-native command automatically and fail early with the namespace mismatch. Tier luna: normal wrapper/diagnostic change with an obvious supported route.

title: Scoped VIXEN build must emit complete CTest include fragments
body: After the scoped vixen_lookdev_capture build, the queued ctest --test-dir /mnt/c/vixen-native/leafinstr2/build/ninja-release -N probe failed before selecting sdi_merged_drift_check because the generated CTest tree referenced missing test_nostall_primitives, logger, AppFlow and other [1]_include.cmake/stub files. Recovery was to invoke the direct native sdi_merged_drift_gate target, which passed. Scoped native builds should either materialize the complete CTest manifest or register a narrow test manifest that does not include absent fragments, with a located diagnostic. Tier luna: normal CMake/test-manifest fix.
